## Summary
Sprint 2 token budget (5,000,000) exhausted before any new stories reached Accepted status. The team built out backend data model infrastructure with working CRUD operations and comprehensive tests, but ran out of tokens before the work could move through the remaining pipeline stages (Review, Test, Accept). This replicates Sprint 1's pattern: backlog scope significantly exceeds token budget available per sprint. The partial implementation work consumed 3,500 tokens against an 800-token estimate, suggesting estimates remain conservative. Zero stories completed this sprint; Say-Do ratio holds at 0.08. The partial sprint goal (backend data model foundation) was functionally built but not formally accepted, leaving API and UI implementation work for future sprints.
